description: This file defines an abstract class 'EventBusCredentialsAdapter' that integrates a CredentialsService with a Vert.x-based event bus for credential retrieval operations. It handles processing incoming messages, tracing, validation, and delegating requests to the underlying service, with support for custom and standard credential fetch actions.

classes.name: EventBusCredentialsAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class that binds credential service requests to the Vert.x event bus and manages trace spans, validation, and delegation to the underlying CredentialsService.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Main method to process incoming credential requests, routing to either 'get' or custom operation processing.

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Handles 'get' credential requests by validating parameters and routing to specific get handlers.

methods.name: processGetByDeviceIdRequest
methods.description: Stub method for processing get-by-device-id requests, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: processGetByAuthIdRequest
methods.description: Engages the CredentialsService to retrieve credentials based on auth ID and constructs response messages.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates and starts a new tracing span with relevant tags, optionally including tenant ID.

methods.name: processCustomCredentialsMessage
methods.description: Default handler for unsupported custom operations, returning a failed future with HTTP 400 error.
